The '''Dimea system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Dimean sector/Legends|Dimean sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Dimean]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="KotOR" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dimea system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square P-13.<ref name="EAOC" />
